MTAR Technologies Appoints New Chief Operating Officer to Drive Growth

Hyderabad—MTAR Technologies Ltd, a leading player in India's precision engineering and machinery sector, announced on Monday the appointment of Ashwin Kumar as its new Chief Operating Officer (COO), effective July 1. The appointment comes as the company seeks to accelerate its expansion and strengthen operational efficiency in response to growing demand across its end-user segments.

Kumar brings over two decades of experience in manufacturing operations and supply chain management. Prior to joining MTAR Technologies Ltd, he served in senior operational roles at several prominent engineering firms, where he was credited with implementing cost optimization initiatives and digital transformation projects. Kumar holds a postgraduate degree in mechanical engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras.

Commenting on the appointment, Parvathi Rao, Chairperson and Managing Director of MTAR Technologies Ltd, said, “We are pleased to welcome Ashwin Kumar to our leadership team. His deep expertise in driving operational excellence and his commitment to innovation align perfectly with our strategic priorities. As we continue to expand our product portfolio and enter new markets, his leadership will be invaluable.”

The move is seen by industry analysts as a signal of MTAR Technologies Ltd’s intent to further consolidate its position in the machinery sector. “The machinery industry in India has rebounded strongly post-pandemic, with double-digit growth in capital goods orders,” said Rajeev Sethi, Vice President of the Indian Machinery Manufacturers Association. “Senior leadership with an eye for efficiency and technology adoption is crucial at this juncture, and MTAR’s latest appointment reflects that awareness.”

MTAR Technologies Ltd, headquartered in Hyderabad, manufactures high-precision components and assemblies for aerospace, energy, and industrial applications. The company reported a revenue growth of 18% for the previous fiscal year, driven by strong order inflows from both domestic and international customers. Its recent investments in advanced manufacturing facilities and digitization have been widely recognized by industry observers.

Ashwin Kumar stated, “I am excited to join MTAR Technologies at such a pivotal time. My immediate focus will be on enhancing operational agility and supporting the company’s ambitious growth plans, while upholding our commitment to quality and sustainability.”

Shares of MTAR Technologies Ltd closed 2.1% higher on the National Stock Exchange following the announcement. The company said Kumar will work closely with the existing management team to ensure a smooth transition and to build on the operational improvements already underway.
